h: Jarvis tells critics to stop pushing her to respect Peller
p: Streamer Jarvis has hit back at people urging her to show more respect to her husband Peller, saying they should stop forcing it because the respect is not there. She added that women reflect whatever they are given in a relationship. The remarks have sparked fresh reactions online, about two months into their reported marriage.
more: "Whatever you show us is what we will reflect back," Jarvis said.
The comments follow the couple's recent public clashes, including a row over her younger sister.
Fans are divided, with many pointing out that respect in a marriage has to go both ways.
alt: Peller and Jarvis pose side by side in matching white England football shirts
